stemMarkdown: A train 180 m long travelling at 63 km/h overtakes a man walking at 9 km/h in the same direction as the train. How many seconds does the train take to pass him completely? (Round to 4 decimal places.)
solutionMarkdown: Same direction, so the speeds subtract: $63 - 9 = 54$ km/h $= 15.0000$ m/s. The train covers its own length relative to the man: $\dfrac{180}{15.0000} = 12.0$ seconds.
altSolutionMarkdown: A man is treated as having no length — only the train's length counts.
